intent: Six original decorative running preference companions; never evidence of health, performance, score quality, or saving success.

generator.execution: Six independent image calls in one concurrent series. No API/CLI fallback.

styleReference.role: Inspected locally for palette and matte material only; not transmitted to image generation.
styleReference.palette: muted teal, warm ivory, warm neutral animal tones

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original TrainOracle running-preference companion character, a tiny mobile UI illustration, one of a coherent six-animal series.
Scene/backdrop: true transparent alpha canvas. No scene, no floor, no drop shadow, no pedestal or framing shape.
Style/medium: original soft matte-clay 3D toy character, gently rounded volumes, minimal dark bead eyes, small kind closed smile, simple smooth matte surfaces without fur strands. Use the existing TrainOracle visual palette: restrained deep muted teal and warm ivory clothing, warm neutral accents, very soft lighting and matte material. Do not depict the reference human and do not copy any existing company mascot.
Composition: one single gender-neutral animal, full body including all ears, tail, hands and both shoes. Front-facing gentle three-quarter pose at eye level, large head about 45 percent body height, compact limbs, clear bold readable silhouette at only 80px. Center the entire character and prop in a square image occupying roughly 78 percent of the height with generous fully transparent padding. High quality polished game-ready still render.
Wardrobe: plain muted deep teal short-sleeve running top, simple warm ivory running shorts, chunky warm ivory running shoes, no marks or logos. All six belong to exactly the same style series.
Lighting: broad soft studio light upper left, low contrast shaded volume, no shiny plastic or harsh reflections.
Constraints: completely original artwork, friendly calm approachable expression, readable simple silhouette. No letters, words, numbers, logos, medals, trophies, ranks, score display, confetti, victory gestures, health or medical implication, sweat, fatigue, speed lines, floating symbols, background, border, extra props or extra characters.

Subject and pose: A warm muted sandy terracotta FOX runner with cream muzzle and chest, rounded triangular ears, one small curled bushy tail. Standing comfortably holding a small closed cream NOTEBOOK with a plain teal spine against the chest in both paws. No pencil or visible writing.
